# Purpose

This notebook creates an analysis-ready four-stage AFIS dataset for the
2022 qFL-Chr.25 end-use evaluation.

The workflow:

1. imports the validated master sample key;
2. imports the `Afis Avg` worksheet;
3. reconstructs the base Fiber ID and processing stage;
4. joins AFIS records to genotype and field information;
5. standardizes AFIS trait names;
6. audits missing values and duplicate records;
7. creates long- and wide-format datasets;
8. saves processed data and audit outputs.

# 1. Locate required files

```{r locate-files}
sample_key_file <- file.path(
  paths$data_processed,
  "sample_key_2022.csv"
)

afis_matches <- list.files(
  paths$data_raw,
  pattern = "^UGA AFIS Results.*\\.xlsx$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

if (!file.exists(sample_key_file)) {
  stop(
    "The validated sample key was not found:\n",
    sample_key_file
  )
}

if (length(afis_matches) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No AFIS workbook was found in:\n",
    paths$data_raw
  )
}

if (length(afis_matches) > 1) {
  stop(
    "More than one AFIS workbook was found:\n",
    paste(
      basename(afis_matches),
      collapse = "\n"
    )
  )
}

afis_file <- afis_matches

file_check <- tibble::tibble(
  file_type = c(
    "Validated sample key",
    "AFIS workbook"
  ),
  filename = c(
    basename(sample_key_file),
    basename(afis_file)
  ),
  exists = c(
    file.exists(sample_key_file),
    file.exists(afis_file)
  ),
  full_path = c(
    sample_key_file,
    afis_file
  )
)

file_check
```

# 4. Locate AFIS identifier columns

```{r column-detection-helper}
find_column <- function(
  data,
  candidates,
  required = TRUE,
  description = "required"
) {

  detected <- candidates[
    candidates %in% names(data)
  ][1]

  if (
    length(detected) == 0 ||
    is.na(detected)
  ) {

    if (required) {
      stop(
        "\nCould not locate the ",
        description,
        " column.\n\nCandidate names:\n",
        paste(
          candidates,
          collapse = ", "
        ),
        "\n\nAvailable columns:\n",
        paste(
          names(data),
          collapse = ", "
        )
      )
    }

    return(
      NA_character_
    )
  }

  detected
}
```

```{r locate-afis-identifiers}
afis_sample_col <- find_column(
  afis_raw,
  candidates = c(
    "sample",
    "sample_id",
    "fiber_id",
    "fiberid",
    "id"
  ),
  description = "AFIS Fiber ID"
)

afis_run_col <- find_column(
  afis_raw,
  candidates = c(
    "run_number",
    "run",
    "minispin_run",
    "process_id"
  ),
  required = FALSE,
  description = "MiniSpin run"
)

afis_stage_col <- find_column(
  afis_raw,
  candidates = c(
    "processing_stage",
    "stage",
    "process_stage",
    "processing"
  ),
  required = FALSE,
  description = "processing stage"
)

afis_identifier_map <- tibble::tibble(
  analysis_variable = c(
    "AFIS Fiber ID",
    "MiniSpin run",
    "Processing stage"
  ),

  source_column = c(
    afis_sample_col,
    afis_run_col,
    afis_stage_col
  )
)

afis_identifier_map
```

# 5. Reconstruct base Fiber ID and processing stage

The AFIS sample suffixes represent the four processing stages:

| AFIS suffix | Processing stage |
|---|---|
| none | Bale |
| A | Opened |
| B | Carded |
| C3 | Sliver |

```{r create-afis-identifiers}
afis_identifiers <- tibble::tibble(

  afis_row_id = seq_len(
    nrow(afis_raw)
  ),

  afis_fiber_id_original = clean_identifier(
    as.character(
      afis_raw[[afis_sample_col]]
    )
  ),

  minispin_run = if (!is.na(afis_run_col)) {

    clean_identifier(
      as.character(
        afis_raw[[afis_run_col]]
      )
    )

  } else {

    NA_character_

  },

  processing_stage_original = if (!is.na(afis_stage_col)) {

    as.character(
      afis_raw[[afis_stage_col]]
    )

  } else {

    NA_character_

  }

) |>
  dplyr::mutate(

    afis_suffix = dplyr::case_when(

      stringr::str_detect(
        afis_fiber_id_original,
        stringr::regex(
          "C3$",
          ignore_case = TRUE
        )
      ) ~ "C3",

      stringr::str_detect(
        afis_fiber_id_original,
        stringr::regex(
          "A$",
          ignore_case = TRUE
        )
      ) ~ "A",

      stringr::str_detect(
        afis_fiber_id_original,
        stringr::regex(
          "B$",
          ignore_case = TRUE
        )
      ) ~ "B",

      TRUE ~ "None"
    ),

    # Remove the stage suffix to recover the base Fiber ID.
    # C3 must be removed before single-letter suffixes.
    fiber_id = afis_fiber_id_original |>
      stringr::str_remove(
        stringr::regex(
          "C3$",
          ignore_case = TRUE
        )
      ) |>
      stringr::str_remove(
        stringr::regex(
          "[AB]$",
          ignore_case = TRUE
        )
      ) |>
      as.character() |>
      clean_identifier(),

    stage_from_suffix = dplyr::case_when(
      afis_suffix == "None" ~ "Bale",
      afis_suffix == "A" ~ "Opened",
      afis_suffix == "B" ~ "Carded",
      afis_suffix == "C3" ~ "Sliver",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    stage_from_column = if (!is.na(afis_stage_col)) {

      standardize_stage(
        processing_stage_original
      )

    } else {

      NA_character_

    },

    processing_stage = dplyr::coalesce(
      stage_from_column,
      stage_from_suffix
    ),

    stage_agreement = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(stage_from_column) ~ NA,
      stage_from_column == stage_from_suffix ~ TRUE,
      TRUE ~ FALSE
    ),

    processing_stage = factor(
      processing_stage,
      levels = c(
        "Bale",
        "Opened",
        "Carded",
        "Sliver"
      ),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )

dplyr::glimpse(
  afis_identifiers
)

tibble::tibble(
  variable = c(
    "fiber_id",
    "minispin_run"
  ),
  class = c(
    class(afis_identifiers$fiber_id)[1],
    class(afis_identifiers$minispin_run)[1]
  )
)
```

# 7. Identify AFIS trait columns

All identifier and descriptive columns are excluded before trait data are
converted to long format.

```{r identify-trait-columns}
identifier_columns <- unique(
  stats::na.omit(
    c(
      afis_sample_col,
      afis_run_col,
      afis_stage_col
    )
  )
)

candidate_trait_columns <- setdiff(
  names(afis_raw),
  identifier_columns
)

trait_column_classes <- tibble::tibble(
  original_column = candidate_trait_columns,

  data_class = purrr::map_chr(
    afis_raw[
      candidate_trait_columns
    ],
    ~ class(.x)[1]
  ),

  nonmissing_values = purrr::map_int(
    afis_raw[
      candidate_trait_columns
    ],
    ~ sum(!is.na(.x))
  ),

  unique_values = purrr::map_int(
    afis_raw[
      candidate_trait_columns
    ],
    ~ dplyr::n_distinct(
      .x,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )
)

trait_column_classes
```

# 8. Create a cleaned AFIS trait-name dictionary

```{r create-trait-dictionary}
trait_dictionary <- tibble::tibble(
  original_trait = candidate_trait_columns
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(

    clean_trait = janitor::make_clean_names(
      original_trait
    ),

    trait_label = dplyr::case_when(

      clean_trait == "nep_size_um" ~ "Nep_size",

      clean_trait == "neps_per_gm" ~ "Nep_count",

      clean_trait == "l_w_in" ~ "L_w",

      clean_trait == "l_w_cv_percent" ~ "L_w_CV",

      clean_trait == "uql_w_in" ~ "UQL_w",

      clean_trait == "sfc_w_percent" ~ "SFC_w",

      clean_trait == "l_n_in" ~ "L_n",

      clean_trait == "l_n_cv_percent" ~ "L_n_CV",

      clean_trait == "sfc_n_percent" ~ "SFC_n",

      clean_trait == "l5_percent_n_in" ~ "L5_n",

      clean_trait == "total_cnt_g" ~ "Total_count",

      clean_trait == "trash_size_um" ~ "Trash_size",

      clean_trait == "dust_cnt_g" ~ "Dust_count",

      clean_trait == "trash_cnt_g" ~ "Trash_count",

      clean_trait == "vfm_percent" ~ "VFM",

      clean_trait == "scn_size_um" ~ "SCN_size",

      clean_trait == "scn_cnt_g" ~ "SCN_count",

      clean_trait == "fine_m_tex" ~ "Fineness",

      clean_trait == "ifc_percent" ~ "IFC",

      clean_trait == "mat_ratio" ~ "Maturity_ratio",

      TRUE ~ clean_trait
    )
  )

trait_dictionary
```

The automatically assigned labels should be reviewed before modeling. The
original trait name is retained in every processed dataset.

# 9. Convert AFIS trait values to numeric form

Some Excel columns may be imported as character because of symbols or
embedded text. This step safely parses the trait values.

```{r create-afis-trait-long}
# Confirm that the trait dictionary exists and has the required columns.
required_dictionary_columns <- c(
  "original_trait",
  "clean_trait",
  "trait_label"
)

missing_dictionary_columns <- setdiff(
  required_dictionary_columns,
  names(trait_dictionary)
)

if (length(missing_dictionary_columns) > 0) {
  stop(
    "The trait dictionary is missing these columns: ",
    paste(
      missing_dictionary_columns,
      collapse = ", "
    ),
    ". Rerun Section 8 before continuing."
  )
}

afis_trait_long <- afis_raw |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    afis_row_id = dplyr::row_number()
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(
    afis_row_id,
    dplyr::all_of(candidate_trait_columns)
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -afis_row_id,
    names_to = "original_trait",
    values_to = "raw_value",
    values_transform = list(
      raw_value = as.character
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    trait_dictionary |>
      dplyr::select(
        original_trait,
        clean_trait,
        trait_label
      ),
    by = "original_trait"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    value = readr::parse_number(
      raw_value,
      na = c(
        "",
        "NA",
        "N/A",
        ".",
        "-",
        "--"
      )
    )
  )

# Stop if the dictionary failed to match any AFIS trait names.
unmatched_trait_names <- afis_trait_long |>
  dplyr::filter(
    is.na(clean_trait)
  ) |>
  dplyr::distinct(
    original_trait
  )

if (nrow(unmatched_trait_names) > 0) {
  print(unmatched_trait_names)

  stop(
    "Some AFIS traits did not match the trait dictionary."
  )
}

dplyr::glimpse(
  afis_trait_long
)

afis_trait_long |>
  dplyr::distinct(
    original_trait,
    clean_trait,
    trait_label
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    original_trait
  )
```

# 11. Join the validated sample key

```{r join-sample-key}
sample_key_variables <- sample_key |>
  dplyr::select(
    field_sample_id,
    genotype_original,
    genotype,
    background,
    nil_set,
    qtl_status,
    material_type,
    micro_id,

  )
```

```{r perform-sample-key-join}
afis_long <- afis_long_unmatched |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    sample_key_variables,
    by = c(
      "fiber_id",
      "minispin_run"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(

    afis_record_matched =
      !is.na(field_sample_id),

    field_rep = field_rep_inferred,

    qtl_status = factor(
      qtl_status,
      levels = c(
        "Negative",
        "Positive",
        "Parent_Check"
      )
    ),

    processing_stage = factor(
      processing_stage,
      levels = c(
        "Bale",
        "Opened",
        "Carded",
        "Sliver"
      ),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(
    field_sample_id,
    genotype_original,
    genotype,
    background,
    nil_set,
    qtl_status,
    material_type,
    field_rep,
    plot,
    micro_id,
    fiber_id,
    minispin_run,
    processing_stage,
    afis_fiber_id_original,
    afis_suffix,
    original_trait,
    clean_trait,
    trait_label,
    raw_value,
    value,
    hvi_length_for_ratch,
    ratch,
    stage_agreement,
    afis_record_matched
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    field_sample_id,
    processing_stage,
    trait_label
  )

dplyr::glimpse(
  afis_long
)
```

# 14. Trait-level missingness audit

```{r trait-missingness-audit}
trait_missingness <- afis_long |>
  dplyr::group_by(
    original_trait,
    clean_trait,
    trait_label
  ) |>
  dplyr::summarise(

    total_records = dplyr::n(),

    nonmissing_records = sum(
      !is.na(value)
    ),

    missing_records = sum(
      is.na(value)
    ),

    missing_percent =
      100 * missing_records / total_records,

    minimum = if (
      all(is.na(value))
    ) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      min(
        value,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    },

    maximum = if (
      all(is.na(value))
    ) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      max(
        value,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    },

    mean = if (
      all(is.na(value))
    ) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      mean(
        value,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    },

    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    dplyr::desc(
      missing_percent
    ),
    trait_label
  )

trait_missingness
```

# 16. Create the sample-stage wide dataset

This dataset retains one row per field sample and processing stage, with one
column per AFIS trait.

```{r create-sample-stage-wide-data}
afis_sample_stage_wide <- afis_long |>
  dplyr::select(
    field_sample_id,
    genotype,
    background,
    nil_set,
    qtl_status,
    material_type,
    field_rep,
    plot,
    micro_id,
    fiber_id,
    minispin_run,
    processing_stage,
    original_trait,
    value
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = original_trait,
    values_from = value
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    field_sample_id,
    processing_stage
  )

dplyr::glimpse(
  afis_sample_stage_wide
)
```

Expected dimensions are approximately:

```text
368 rows = 92 samples × 4 processing stages
```

# 17. Create the fully wide stage-by-trait dataset

This dataset contains one row per field sample. Each AFIS trait is separated
by processing stage.

```{r create-fully-wide-data}
afis_wide <- afis_long |>
  dplyr::select(
    field_sample_id,
    genotype,
    background,
    nil_set,
    qtl_status,
    material_type,
    field_rep,
    plot,
    micro_id,
    fiber_id,
    minispin_run,
    processing_stage,
    clean_trait,
    value
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = c(
      processing_stage,
      clean_trait
    ),
    values_from = value,
    names_glue = "{processing_stage}_{clean_trait}"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    field_sample_id
  )

dplyr::glimpse(
  afis_wide
)
```

# 18. Create a primary-trait subset

The automatic trait labels must be inspected before final analysis. This
subset retains traits provisionally identified as biologically important.

```{r create-primary-trait-subset}
primary_trait_labels <- c(
  "L_n",
  "L_n_CV",
  "L_w",
  "L_w_CV",
  "UQL_w",
  "L5_n",
  "SFC_n",
  "SFC_w",
  "Fineness",
  "Maturity_ratio",
  "IFC",
  "Nep_count",
  "Nep_size"
)

afis_primary_long <- afis_long |>
  dplyr::filter(
    trait_label %in%
      primary_trait_labels
  )

afis_primary_long |>
  dplyr::count(
    trait_label,
    original_trait,
    sort = TRUE
  )
```

# 19. Create final cleaning audit

```{r create-final-audit}
afis_cleaning_audit <- tibble::tibble(

  check = c(
    "Raw AFIS rows",
    "Expected raw AFIS rows",
    "Unique base Fiber IDs",
    "Unique MiniSpin runs",
    "Unique field samples matched",
    "Bale records",
    "Opened records",
    "Carded records",
    "Sliver records",
    "Samples with all four stages",
    "Unmatched sample-stage records",
    "Duplicate sample-stage-trait records",
    "Long-format rows",
    "Sample-stage wide rows",
    "Fully wide rows"
  ),

  observed = c(
    nrow(afis_raw),
    368,

    dplyr::n_distinct(
      afis_identifiers$fiber_id,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    dplyr::n_distinct(
      afis_identifiers$minispin_run,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    dplyr::n_distinct(
      afis_long$field_sample_id,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    sum(
      afis_identifiers$processing_stage ==
        "Bale",
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    sum(
      afis_identifiers$processing_stage ==
        "Opened",
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    sum(
      afis_identifiers$processing_stage ==
        "Carded",
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    sum(
      afis_identifiers$processing_stage ==
        "Sliver",
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    sum(
      sample_stage_completeness$all_four_stages
    ),

    nrow(
      unmatched_afis_records
    ),

    nrow(
      duplicate_sample_stage_traits
    ),

    nrow(
      afis_long
    ),

    nrow(
      afis_sample_stage_wide
    ),

    nrow(
      afis_wide
    )
  ),

  expected = c(
    368,
    368,
    92,
    92,
    92,
    92,
    92,
    92,
    92,
    92,
    0,
    0,
    NA,
    368,
    92
  )
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(

    status = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(expected) ~ "INFORMATION",
      observed == expected ~ "PASS",
      TRUE ~ "REVIEW"
    )
  )

afis_cleaning_audit
```

  "\nAFIS data cleaning completed."
)

  nrow(afis_raw)
)

  dplyr::n_distinct(
    afis_long$field_sample_id,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),

)

message(
  "\nSamples with all four stages: ",
  sum(
    sample_stage_completeness$all_four_stages
  ),
  " of 92"
)

message(
  "\nUnmatched AFIS sample-stage records: ",
  nrow(
    unmatched_afis_records
  )
)

message(
  "\nDuplicate sample-stage-trait records: ",
  nrow(
    duplicate_sample_stage_traits
  )
)

message(
  "\nClean long-format data saved to:\n",
  file.path(
    paths$data_processed,
    "afis_2022_clean_long.csv"
  )
)

message(
  "\nClean wide-format data saved to:\n",
  file.path(

  )
)
